notes.title: Into the Sunset
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today we have some sad news. We are sunsetting the sales for Faster Racer Boom Boom. This means you will no longer be able to access it on January 2025. 

Thank you to all the kind words and many games from the community and fans... and stay tuned as we will have something new on the horizon.
